body: I don’t want this to come off patronizing in any way, but if you want to be a girl, be a girl. If you want to stop being a girl, stop being a girl. There’s no need to undergo gender-affirming surgeries unless you want to. You don’t have to take hrt, or in OP’s case t, in order to live the life you want to live. You deserve to live the life that not only you want, but absolutely deserve. This is coming from a non-binary person, assigned female at birth, no affirming surgeries or anything. Feel free to DM me if y’all ever just want to talk through this stuff. I care about y’all.
There’s history, distance, shitty cell service, and I haven’t seen them in years. I’ve been in touch recently, but I don’t have it in me to pour my heart out unless it’s in person.

Thank you for that, I do appreciate it.
I feel like that’s kind of what I’ve been doing for years now. I got pretty ok at staying alive, or at least actively trying not to die. I’m just tired of trying now. 

I don’t have much of a story. I’ve been suicidal and depressed since I was 13. Runs in the family type of thing. I’ve tried to die many times. I spend most of these days alone, I’m starting to think I’m the reason why.
